EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT( CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
Land Ministry’s No.: 4-3/6/2016/HW/178.
My Reference No.: BER/4/5/5/10.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land/ servitude to be acquired:

The allotments of Land (Lot Nos. 01-35)depicted Surveyor General’s Plan No. ක 4730 is situated at Village of Maggona West and Ediriligoda, Grama Niladhari’s Division of 742-Maggona West and 746 Ediriligoda, in Divisional Secretariat Division of Beruwala in Kalutara District, Western Province, bounded as follows in total extent of 0.2806 Hectare.
